recommendation: Keep the source fix. It aligns the search narrative with the Applied FHIR-I decision while preserving the separate canonical reference matching guidance from FHIR-52895.
issue_request: FHIR-46311 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and asked whether canonical version searches using the version parameter or [canonical]|[version] should default to semantic/version hierarchy matching or exact matching. The accepted resolution says default canonical version search is a token search (exact match), and callers wanting version hierarchy searches should use :below.
initial_application: The issue had been applied by PR #3967 in git commit 2007d0bc3811bb1444904a1709781768d3766cb9, which added text to source/search.html. That text made ordinary versioned canonical searches use the target resource's versionAlgorithm when known and fall back to exact only when unknown, so the applied wording did not match the exact-token Jira and minutes decision.
additional_context: The linked July 2024 Zulip thread collected implementer behavior and showed exact matching in HAPI, Google, Firely, and Aidbox. FHIR-I minutes on 2024-07-29 record the final FHIR-46311 decision as exact token default with hierarchy through :below. Later FHIR-52895 clarified general canonical reference version matching in source/references.html; that remains separate from this search-parameter default.
reconciliation: Updated source/search.html, the active source for the Search page cited by the Jira related URL, to state that an unmodified [canonical]|[version] search matches the version exactly using token semantics and that versionAlgorithm-based hierarchy matching requires a supported modifier such as :above or :below.
source_changes: source/search.html: Clarified that unmodified [canonical]|[version] searches use exact token matching and do not apply versionAlgorithm hierarchy matching unless a supported modifier is requested.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied issue governing general canonical reference and wildcard matching in references.html; it is related context but not decided here because FHIR-46311 is limited to search default behavior.
